mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol enhances hepatic synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors (II, VII, IX, X), potentially reducing the anticoagulant effect of warfarin if vitamin K intake is variable or increasing thrombotic risk.
action: Monitor patients on concurrent ethinyl estradiol for consistent vitamin K intake; counsel on dietary stability and consider INR monitoring if warfarin is also used; assess thrombotic risk.
